# MatchLens: live SLOs
Event-driven pipeline health. **Hot path SLO:** p95 event → cue pushed < 1 s. **Warm path SLO:** p50 verified explanation < 10 s. **Fallback rate SLO:** < 10%.

content.query: AppTraces | where Message startswith 'cue_published' | parse Message with 'cue_published match=' match ' source=' source ' template=' template ' latency_ms=' ms:long | summarize p50=percentile(ms, 50), p95=percentile(ms, 95) by source, bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
content.title: Event → cue pushed to Web PubSub (ms), by path

content.query: AppTraces | where Message startswith 'cue_published' and Message has 'source=template' | parse Message with * 'latency_ms=' ms:long | summarize p50=percentile(ms,50), p95=percentile(ms,95), p99=percentile(ms,99), cues=count()
content.title: Hot path p95 vs SLO (last 6 h)

content.query: union AppTraces, AppDependencies | where AppRoleName in ('interpreter','storyteller','api','simulator','replay') | summarize replicas=dcount(AppRoleInstance) by AppRoleName, bin(TimeGenerated, 1m)
content.title: Active replicas per service (instances emitting telemetry)

content.query: AppTraces | where AppRoleName == 'storyteller' and Message has 'cues via' | extend outcome = case(Message has 'resumed', 'resumed from checkpoint', Message has 'via fallback', 'fallback', 'agent (verified)') | summarize moments=count() by outcome, bin(TimeGenerated, 15m)
content.title: Storyteller outcomes (agent / fallback / resumed)

content.query: AppTraces | where AppRoleName == 'storyteller' and Message has 'cues via' | parse Message with 'moment ' moment ' (' mkind '): ' cues:int ' cues via ' source ' in ' ms:long ' ms' rest | summarize n=count(), p50=percentile(ms,50), p95=percentile(ms,95) by mkind
content.title: Workflow latency by moment kind (ms)

content.query: union AppRequests, AppDependencies | where TimeGenerated > ago(6h) | summarize calls=count() by AppRoleName, bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
content.title: Throughput: calls per minute by service

content.query: AppTraces | where AppRoleName == 'storyteller' and Message startswith 'deployment ' | parse Message with 'deployment ' deployment ' failed: ' error | summarize failures=count() by deployment, reason=tostring(split(error, ' ')[0])
content.title: Model failures and fallbacks by deployment

content.query: AppTraces | where Message has_any ('CHAOS', 'resuming', 'claimed partition', 'released partition', 'dropped', 'restored') | project TimeGenerated, AppRoleName, Message | order by TimeGenerated desc | take 50
content.title: Resilience events (chaos drills, resumes, partition moves, dropped ticks)

content.query: AppTraces | where AppRoleName == 'replay' and Message startswith 'replay ' | project TimeGenerated, Message | order by TimeGenerated desc
content.title: Replays packaged (event-driven job)
